answers.core: Honestly I wasn't sure whether to post this on proposals or issues. I couldn't find any post anywhere talking about it, but I figure it's probably some technical limitation that I hope could be changed?
answers.workaround:
Only work around I can figure out is making sure the loaded resource is never on the same level hierarchy. For example if I put them both into their own blend tree I can name them however I want.

The issue is this creates long-winded hierarchies inside my tree, where its `tree_root -> left_arm -> left_arm_tree -> transition` instead of just `tree_root -> left_arm -> transition`

title: Allow assigning unique names to AnimationNode resources that are loaded from file into the blend tree
